text: Based on the evidence, the property did not experience deforestation in 2020. The tool detected a tree-cover loss event of 67.7 ha in 2020, but the JRC GFC2020 data indicates that there was no forest on the property in 2020. Deforestation is defined as the conversion of forest land to non-forest land, so the loss of tree cover on a property that was not classified as forest cannot be considered deforestation. The evidence supports that no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected within the asset between 2021 and 2025.
